title: Metautism
description:
Dive into the rich spectrum of autism with The Metautism Podcast. Join us for insightful conversations featuring autistic individuals, experts, advocates, and educators, all dedicated to building a world of equal opportunities. 

As a part of the Green ASC VET project, our podcast actively supports the project's mission of promoting the inclusion of autistic individuals in vocational education and employment. 

Subscribe and stay up to date with the newest episode releases or connect with us on social media.


*Funded by the European Union. Views and opinions expressed are however those of the author(s) only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA). Neither the European Union nor EACEA can be held responsible for them.
